zh: 团队按技能排序后相邻差不超过1，等价于团队的技能值铺成一段中间没有大于1空隙的区域，可以跨越多个不同的技能值。
把全部技能排序：如果某处相邻差大于1，任何团队都无法跨过这个空隙；而同一段没有空隙的连续区域里，所有人可以全部选入。
排序后扫描，相邻差不超过1时当前段长度加1，否则重置为1，同时记录最大段长作为答案。技能差可能达到2×10^9，比较时注意整数范围。
en: Requiring adjacent skills to differ by at most 1 after sorting means the team's skills cover a stretch with no gap larger than 1, which may span several different skill values.
Sort all skills: if two neighbors differ by more than 1, no team can cross that gap, while everyone inside one gap-free stretch can be chosen together.

After sorting, scan the array: when the adjacent difference is at most 1, extend the current run by 1, otherwise reset it to 1, and keep the longest run as the answer. Differences can reach 2×10^9, so mind the integer range.

explanationEn:
## Approach

After sorting, accumulate the length of each run whose adjacent differences are ≤1, and start over whenever a larger gap appears.

## Proof of correctness

No valid team can cross a gap of missing skills larger than 1; choosing everyone in the same gap-free run at once is still valid, and removing anyone cannot increase the count. So the longest run is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
